name: Rocket.Chat GSoC Demo Day 2026
description:
Rocket.Chat Demo Day returns for 2026 with a new generation of open-source builders presenting what they are creating during Google Summer of Code.

Join Rocket.Chat leaders, mentors, community members, and ten GSoC contributors for live demonstrations spanning AI-assisted development, moderation, integrations, accessibility, performance, administration, and the future of embedded collaboration. The program opens with a welcome from the Rocket.Chat team, followed by focused project demos and live insights from the contributors building them.
